relationships.subject: trigeminal system activation
relationships.evidence_quote: supports a role for trigeminal activation in the pathophysiology of headache in this viral infection

relationships.subject: alpha-CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP is known to enhance interleukin-6 production, the main biomarker of COVID-19 severity

key_findings: Serum alpha-CGRP was elevated in COVID-19 inpatients with headache (55.2 pg/mL) vs controls (33.9 pg/mL), and also in those without headache.
Findings support trigeminal activation in COVID-19 headache.
